characters.name: Lillekort
characters.description: Født i en trang leilighet og går ut i verden samme dag, en kvikk, fryktløs småtass som får tak i «umulige» gjenstander og bruker dem til å redde andre—uten å kreve æren.
characters.look: A small, bold boy only minutes old but already the size of a child of about six, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined little chin and a mop of golden curls. An oversized knitted beanie with blue-and-white stripes flops over one ear. He wears his big brothers' hand-me-downs: a huge, faded navy-blue hoodie with the sleeves pushed up, grey trousers a little too big for him, rolled at the ankles, and worn white trainers with holes in the toes.

characters.name: Lillekort i gullkledningen
characters.description: Lillekort i gulldrakten som prinsesse Nora trakk på ham mens han sov. Den er tynn som folie, og han skjuler den under hettegenseren helt til bryllupet.
characters.look: The same small, bold boy, the size of a child of about six, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined little chin and a mop of golden curls under his oversized blue-and-white striped beanie. He now wears a shining garment of gold as thin as foil, which fits him like a second skin from neck to wrists and ankles and glows with its own warm light, with his worn white trainers still on his feet.

characters.name: Kong Lavring
characters.description: Tvillingbroren som forsvinner ut i verden i motsatt retning, like Lillekort av utseende men mer stolt og brå—og ender som nøkkelen til en rettferdig løsning.
characters.look: A small, bold boy only minutes old but already the size of a child of about six, with exactly the same round face, rosy cheeks, button nose, big cornflower-blue eyes and mop of golden curls as his twin brother, but with a cheeky, know-it-all grin. He wears an oversized red-and-white striped beanie, a far-too-big mustard-yellow puffer jacket with the sleeves rolled up, baggy grey jeans and big green rubber boots.

characters.name: Kong Lavring i Lillekorts klær
characters.description: Kong Lavring i klærne til tvillingbroren, så lik at prinsessene tror det er Lillekort som kommer.
characters.look: The small twin dressed in his brother's clothes, so that nobody can tell the two apart: a bold boy the size of a child of about six, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and a mop of golden curls under an oversized blue-and-white striped beanie, in a shining garment of gold as thin as foil that fits him like a second skin, and worn white trainers.

characters.name: Prinsesse Nora
characters.description: Den yngste prinsessa, fanget i en moderne hoffverden av sorg og plikt, som finner mot til å avsløre sannheten når Lillekort gir henne en plan.
characters.look: A slim, lively princess of about nineteen with a round face, a pointed little chin, a small turned-up nose, big grey eyes, pale skin with pink cheeks and short, bouncy platinum-blonde curls held back by a slim gold hairband. She wears a simple, elegant emerald-green knee-length dress, a fine gold chain with one small pearl, black tights and black ankle boots.

characters.name: Den eldste prinsessa
characters.description: Kongens andre datter, som trollet tok med seg til berget på havbunnen. Der sitter hun og syr til Lillekort kommer, og hun er både størst og sterkest av de to søstrene.
characters.look: A tall, strong, broad-shouldered young woman of about twenty-two, a head taller than her younger sister and quick on her feet, with a round face, a pointed chin, a small turned-up nose, big grey eyes, pink cheeks and thick platinum-blonde curls tumbling to her shoulders, held back with a string of pearls. She wears a long, faded coral-red knitted dress with little white shells sewn along the hem, a plaited silver cord belt and a silver thimble on one finger.

characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.description: En selvutnevnt helt og mediefavoritt som spiller «beskytter» men gjemmer seg når det gjelder, og truer prinsessa til å gi ham æren.
characters.look: The head of the royal guards: a big, burly, barrel-chested man of about forty, a head taller than most men, with a broad, puffy face that easily turns bright red, a big bulbous nose, small shifty pale-blue eyes under bushy brows, curly red hair, a big, well-groomed fiery-red beard and a dazzling, camera-ready smile. He wears a long bright-red coat over a dark-blue guard's uniform with gold buttons, polished black boots and a white handkerchief in his breast pocket.

characters.name: Kjerringa med ett øye
characters.description: Ei gammel, gammel, krokrygget kjerring med handlevogn og bare ett øye. Lillekort møter tre slike, og for å få øyet igjen gir de ham et sverd, et skip og kunsten å brygge.
characters.look: A tiny, ancient woman, no taller than a child and bent so that her back curves like a hook, with a small, deeply wrinkled walnut face, a flat little nose, a wide toothless grin and only one eye: a single round, shiny sky-blue eye in the middle of her forehead that sits loose like a marble. Her thin white hair is in a tiny knot. She wears a faded lavender quilted coat, a brown knitted scarf and orthopaedic shoes, and pulls a battered tartan shopping trolley on two wheels.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen på det gamle slottet ytterst på neset. Han er glad i tradisjoner, har lovet bort den ene datteren til tre troll og har mistet den andre til et troll i havet.
characters.look: A jolly, stocky king of about sixty who loves old traditions, with a big round belly, a broad, ruddy face made for laughing, a bulbous nose, crinkly brown eyes, bushy chestnut eyebrows, thick chestnut curls and a big, round, curly chestnut beard clipped short like a bush. He wears a rust-orange tweed jacket over a cream shirt, brown corduroy trousers and brown brogues and, every day, a small gold crown with seven points tipped with amber beads.

characters.name: Kokken
characters.description: Kokken på kongsgården, som Lillekort bærer ved og vann for, og som får fang på fang med bøyler av gull og sølv.
characters.look: A sturdy, cheerful cook of about twenty-five with a broad, rosy, round face, merry dark-brown eyes, a snub nose dusted with flour and thick black hair wound into a bun under a white hairnet. Her sleeves are rolled up over strong arms. She wears a cornflower-blue chef's jacket, black-and-white checked trousers, a big white apron with soup stains and white clogs, and keeps a large wooden spoon tucked into her apron strings.

characters.name: Trollet med fem hoder
characters.description: Det første av de tre trollene som prinsessa er lovet bort til. Det kommer over sjøen i et svart skip og vasser i land i en storm av skum og vind.
characters.look: A huge, bloated sea troll about five times as tall as a man, with dusky purple-grey skin like an old mussel shell, crusted with barnacles and hung with dark seaweed, a great sagging belly, long dangling arms and flat, webbed feet. It has exactly five heads on five thick, wrinkled necks, each with a long drooping nose, small round yellow eyes and a tuft of shaggy grey hair. It wears a torn fishing net with orange plastic floats around its middle and carries a thick iron bar.

characters.name: Trollet med ti hoder
characters.description: Det andre trollet, dobbelt så stort som det første, med ti hoder og ei enda større jernstang.
characters.look: An enormous sea troll about ten times as tall as a man, with rough slate-blue skin, knobbly and shiny like wet rock, a broad, square body, short thick legs and huge webbed feet. It has exactly ten round heads in two rows of five, one row above the other, each with a flat nose, big goggling green eyes, a wide frog mouth and a scraggly grey beard. It wears a torn black tarpaulin tied around its middle with rope and carries a huge iron bar.

characters.name: Trollet med femten hoder
characters.description: Det tredje og største trollet, med femten hoder og ei jernstang som får sanden til å sprute femten meter til værs.
characters.look: The biggest sea troll of all, as tall as a hill, with dark peat-brown, lumpy skin like a bog, shaggy grey hair on its shoulders, a round belly and legs like old tree stumps. It has exactly fifteen heads stacked in a pyramid, five on its shoulders, then four, three, two and one on top, each with a round red nose, small blinking amber eyes and a shock of grey hair. It wears a huge patched tunic of old sailcloth tied with rope and carries a gigantic iron bar.

characters.name: Havtrollet
characters.description: Et urgammelt troll som lever i en steinfestning på havbunnen og krever det umulige—til Lillekort vender trollfesten mot dem selv med et brygg som slår selv monsterkrefter ut.
characters.look: A fat, hot-tempered troll about three times as tall as a man, with smooth, shiny turquoise skin like a wet fish, a barrel belly, short bowed legs and big flat webbed feet. He has one huge head with a gigantic, wrinkly, trumpet-shaped nose that is always sniffing, bulging pale-orange eyes, bristly orange eyebrows and a long tangle of brown kelp for hair and beard, crusted with salt. He wears baggy faded yellow oilskin trousers held up by a rope and a necklace of big shells.

places.name: the Beach
places.look: A wide, pale sandy beach below the castle on the headland, curving along the open sea. A big, flat grey boulder lies at the water's edge, and at the top of the beach stands a huge, gnarled old oak with spreading branches and yellow-brown leaves. Beach grass grows on the low dunes, and a path with iron railings climbs to the dark stone castle with its glass extensions, towers and antennas.

places.name: the Banquet Hall
places.look: A great, high banquet hall in the old stone castle, with dark stone walls hung with long black drapes, tall arched windows and a ceiling of glittering modern light panels. One very long table laid with white linen, silver and crystal runs down the middle, with a high-backed carved chair at its head and a polished stone floor.

places.name: the Troll Hall
places.look: A vast cave hall inside a rock mountain on the sea floor, where ancient rock meets old industry: rusty pipes run into the walls, sea-green light seeps through cracks, and seaweed and shells cling to the stone. A huge stone oven with a chimney glows red at one end beside two enormous brewing vats, a small closet with a plank door is set into one wall, and a heavy round door opens onto the dark sea.
